headword: {寒冷|かんれい}{前線|ぜんせん}

definitions.explanation: A weather front where a mass of cold air advances and pushes under warmer air. Often brings sudden drops in temperature, strong winds, and heavy but short-lived rain. A standard meteorological term frequently heard in Japanese weather forecasts.

examples.japanese: {寒冷|かんれい}{前線|ぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧。
examples.english: A cold front is passing through.

examples.japanese: {寒冷|かんれい}{前線|ぜんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped sharply due to the cold front.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧{寒冷|かんれい}{前線|ぜんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{雷雨|らいう}→雷雨：15922_raiu⟧や⟦{突風|とっぷう}→突風：15921_toppuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Because a cold front will pass through tonight, please be cautious of thunderstorms and gusts of wind.

notes:
USAGE:
A common term in weather forecasts. Japanese weather reporting uses specific meteorological vocabulary, and understanding front-related terms helps comprehend forecasts.
